source: A FAMISHED FOX saw ... (the whole narration)
lost: No opener marks storytelling: GIVEN claims the events are in the context or observed, so fiction decodes as reported fact.
fix: opener NARRATE (told as story, not vouched for)

lost: First-mention indefinite versus already-known definite is not marked; a bare root is ambiguous between a, the, generic and plural, and only NAMED handles track identity.
fix: rule: bare root without handle = new/indefinite; handle = definite (state it in the spec)

lost: Singular versus plural is unmarked, and SOME does not say whether one or several.
fix: quantifier slot: add MANY (plural) beside the numerals

lost: The perceiver has to be coded AGENT (who acts) though seeing is not an action; there is no experiencer role.
fix: state that AGENT covers experiencers, or add role EXPERIENCER

lost: Ability (can/could) has no construct; I used a root 'able' with a FOR block, which is close to smuggling a modal in as a content word.
fix: modal slot after aspect: CAN, MUST, MAY

source: for she could not reach them
lost: There is no sentence relation for 'the reason is'; RESULT only runs the other way, so the reason had to be embedded as a CAUSE block.
fix: relation REASON (inverse of RESULT)

lost: The sense that the event comes finally, after long effort and delay, is lost; SEQUENCE plus 'WHEN end' gives only order.
fix: phase particles in the aspect slot: STILL, ALREADY, FINALLY

source: turned away, hiding her disappointment and saying
lost: Simultaneity of three actions is not expressible between sentences (only SEQUENCE); hiding was pushed into a WITH manner block and saying became a separate ADD sentence with no time link.
fix: relation MEANWHILE (same time as target sentence)

source: saying: "The Grapes are sour, and not ripe as I thought."
lost: Direct speech cannot be given in the language: a block holds one clause, so the quote became three separate 'say' sentences, and the speaker's 'I' had to be replaced by the handle F because ME always means the writer.
fix: quote block that may hold several sentences and inside which ME/YOU shift to the quoted speaker

source: hanging / are sour / as I thought
lost: The spec does not say whether unmarked or PAST time inside a block is counted from the writer's now or from the containing clause, so 'the grapes are sour (then)' and 'I thought (earlier than saying)' are ambiguous.
fix: rule: time inside a block is relative to the containing clause

lost: Typographic capitals of the fable style are dropped.
fix: none: out of scope

lost: The normative keyword MUST (as against SHOULD or MAY) has no particle; a root 'oblige' carries it only by lexical choice.
fix: modal slot: MUST, SHOULD, MAY

source: A recipient ... a received protocol element ... for it ... the sender
lost: A rule about any arbitrary recipient, element and sender cannot bind its variables in one sentence; I had to stage an ASSUMED scenario sentence to create handles R, E, S, which reads as one particular case.
fix: quantifier ANY whose NAMED handle is a variable scoped over the following sentences until rebound

lost: Exception to a default rule is flattened to IF NOT, losing the rule-plus-exception structure.
fix: body connective UNLESS block block

lost: There is no demonstrative or self-reference to the present document; 'this' became an ordinary new handle D.
fix: head THIS (the present text/document or the thing pointed at)

lost: The scope-widening aside 'including X' had to become a separate ADD sentence repeating the predicate, and it no longer attaches to the noun it clarifies.
fix: linker INCLUDING after a head

lost: OR joins only whole clauses, so a two-word alternative needed an extra sentence with two full blocks, and its parenthetical status is lost.
fix: allow AND / OR between phrases under one role

lost: 'Might' here licenses the server's behaviour and scopes over the consequent only; POSSIBLE is the writer's confidence over the whole IF sentence, so the decoded text reads as a guess about what happens.
fix: modal MAY in the clause-level modal slot, usable inside blocks

source: a specific implementation version ... certain content codings
lost: Specific-but-unnamed reference ('certain') collapses into SOME, which also means any-some.
fix: quantifier PARTICULAR

source: a specific implementation version that is known to fail on receipt of
lost: A relative clause containing further clauses cannot use SELF unambiguously, and the handle is bound only after the modifiers, so the restrictive condition was moved to a BACKGROUND sentence and no longer restricts.
fix: rule: SELF = head of the nearest enclosing KIND block; allow NAMED directly after the head

source: what is implied by those semantics
lost: A headless relative needs a dummy root 'thing' as head.
fix: allow a block alone after KIND-less WHAT-free head, e.g. head THAT

source: their reliability ... and ... how complex bonding affects predictions ... remain unclear
lost: Two coordinated subjects cannot share one predicate; the sentence is split and the predicate repeated.
fix: AND between phrases under one role

lost: Ranking one conjunct above the other needs an extra sentence comparing STEP labels.
fix: none needed beyond AND; or relation ADD with EMPHASIS documented as 'more important'

lost: Persistence of a state up to now (still) is not marked; ONGOING says only that it holds.
fix: aspect slot: STILL

lost: Equal-degree comparison has no construct (THAN gives only 'more'); I used a KIND 'level OF «DFT»' compound.
fix: role AS for the standard of equality

source: Among materials with competing bonding regimes
lost: The partitive frame 'within this class' is stretched onto AT (place).
fix: role AMONG

source: including defective and curved graphitic regions, amorphous regions, and closed/open pores
lost: A five-item non-exhaustive list takes five EXAMPLE sentences, each repeating the predicate.
fix: AND between phrases; linker INCLUDING for non-exhaustive members

lost: The source is vague between regions that are both and two kinds of region; stacked KIND forces 'both', separate sentences force 'two kinds'.
fix: AND between modifiers versus AND between phrases

lost: Authorial 'we' (several authors, excluding the reader) is reduced to singular ME.
fix: head US (writer plus others); separate inclusive form optional

lost: AT is the only place role, so 'inside' versus 'on the surface of' (a real physical difference here) needs relational nouns: AT inside OF, AT surface OF.
fix: document the pattern AT (relational-root OF x); no particle needed

lost: NOT negates a whole clause; negating only the manner (captures, but not accurately) needs an extra wrapping block.
fix: allow NOT before a role phrase or modifier

lost: Distribution over a range of cases ('across') is flattened to AT.
fix: role AMONG (same particle as the partitive)

source: their reliability ... how complex bonding affects ... remain unclear
lost: Embedded questions rely on WHAT inside a non-ASK block, which the spec does not define, and 'how reliable' (a question of degree) has no slot for WHAT at all.
fix: rule: a block containing WHAT is an indirect question; particle WHETHER for embedded yes/no

lost: No opener fits a claim the writer simply asserts on their own authority or argument: it is not in context, not derived from labelled steps, not background recall, and not merely supposed.
fix: opener CLAIM (writer asserts as own position)

source: which are the second objects of human reason
lost: A non-restrictive aside cannot attach to its noun (KIND narrows); it became a separate BACKGROUND sentence.
fix: linker ASIDE for a non-narrowing modifier

source: are the second objects of human reason
lost: The predicate slot takes a bare root, so 'X is a (modified noun phrase)' has no direct form; I used 'equal THEME x TO (phrase)', which claims identity rather than class membership.
fix: allow BE phrase as a predicate outside DEFINE

lost: Ordinals have no construct; I used a root 'second' as a KIND modifier.
fix: linker NTH + number

source: in the same manner ... of a like nature ... the same facility
lost: Sameness and likeness comparisons are forced through roots 'same/similar' with THAN or TO, though THAN is defined only as 'more than'.
fix: role AS for the standard of equality/similarity

lost: Reference back to earlier discourse as an entity works only if that text was labelled or handled; an invented context sentence was needed.
fix: head ABOVE (what was just discussed), or none: excerpt artefact

lost: The 'no matter how great' concessive is lost; a plain IF {great} suggests the difference holds only when the evidence is great.
fix: allow focus EVEN before IF (EVEN IF), with WHAT allowed as a degree

lost: Inclusive generic 'we' (people in general, writer and reader included) has no head; replaced by root 'human'.
fix: head US

lost: Logical possibility as the thing asserted cannot use POSSIBLE (which is the writer's confidence); a root 'possible' is needed and a careless encoder would turn the thesis into a hedge.
fix: modal slot: CAN usable in any clause

lost: Concessive 'still' (possible even though false) is dropped.
fix: aspect slot: STILL

lost: Impossibility plus 'never' needs a wrapped 'NOT possible THEME { ... WHEN SOME time }'; there is no temporal quantifier of the event itself.
fix: document WHEN ALL/NO/SOME time as the frequency pattern

source: because it can never imply ..., and is conceived by the mind
lost: Two coordinated reasons: one fits in a CAUSE block, the other two sentences can only be tied back with BACKGROUND, so their status as reasons is weakened.
fix: relation REASON

source: as if ever so conformable to reality
lost: The counterfactual comparison (as easily as it would be were it true) is replaced by a comparison with things that do conform; no marking that the standard is contrary to fact.
fix: time-slot particle UNREAL for a clause held contrary to fact

lost: Degree intensification has no slot.
fix: degree slot before a root: VERY, SLIGHTLY, TOO, ENOUGH

source: Matters of fact ... are not ascertained / is conceived by the mind
lost: Passives keep the topic first; role order is declared meaningless and no topic marker exists, so what the sentence is about is not recoverable.
fix: rule: first role phrase is the topic

source: let me be very clear ... YOU ARE WRONG
lost: Two layers of force (announced bluntness, then shouting capitals on the conclusion only) collapse into one sentence-level EMPHASIS with no degree and no way to aim it at the consequent.
fix: allow attitude at the start of a block; focus particle usable on the predicate

lost: Acting 'in the capacity of' has no role; a restrictive KIND clause on YOU is used, which reads oddly as 'the you who maintains'.
fix: role AS (shared with the equative proposal)

source: who or what can use your code
lost: Permission 'can' needs a root 'permit' and an extra block; who/what (person or machine) merges into one WHAT.
fix: modal slot: MAY

lost: The limiting 'in technical respects' (with its hint: not necessarily otherwise) is forced onto AT with a dummy noun.
fix: role ABOUT (topic or respect)

lost: Accompaniment has no role: WITH is defined as means or manner, so 'work WITH YOU' decodes as 'work by means of you'.
fix: extend WITH to company, or add role ALONG

lost: Rejecting a conclusion the reader is presumed to draw has no form; NO answers only an actual ASK, so plain NOT loses the 'contrary to what you may think'.
fix: relation CORRECT (rejects an assumed or implied claim)

source: YOU ARE WRONG / I like working with you / my bullshit
lost: Anger, warmth, vulgar register and self-mockery have no attitude; only EMPHASIS, POLITE, REGRET, SURPRISE exist.
fix: attitude list: add ANGER, WARM, BLUNT

lost: Occasional frequency is reachable only as 'WHEN SOME time'; HABIT would overstate it.
fix: document WHEN SOME time; or aspect SOMETIMES

source: I say some stupid things at times
lost: Its role as the justification for the preceding sentence can only be tagged BACKGROUND.
fix: relation REASON

lost: The 'you' addresses one person and, generically, any maintainer; YOU has no number or generic reading.
fix: allow quantifier before YOU (ALL YOU)

lost: The idiom is unpacked into a relative clause.
fix: none: out of scope

lost: There is no speaker field: each turn needs a frame sentence 'say AGENT x THEME STEP n', doubling the text, and it stays unclear whether the framed ASK/REQUEST is also the writer's own act.
fix: optional speaker handle before the opener (S/ ASK ...)

lost: A negative leading question that expects 'yes' is reduced to a neutral ASK with POSSIBLE.
fix: attitude EXPECT (speaker expects agreement)

lost: 'Another/other' needs a relative clause 'NOT same THEME SELF THAN Q'.
fix: focus particle OTHER before a phrase

source: twice as large as this / double
lost: A comparison with a multiple has no place for the factor; I borrowed the logic notation (multiply FIRST 2 SECOND size OF Q), which the phrase grammar does not clearly admit as a head.
fix: role BY for the amount or factor of a comparison

source: this ... that double square ... this is two feet ... that
lost: Pointing words contrast the drawn figure with the imagined one; handles need an invented sentence to bind them and lose the near/far pointing.
fix: heads THIS and THAT

source: having like this the lines equal
lost: Reciprocal 'equal to one another' is only implied by ALL line, and 'like this one' is squeezed into ALSO SELF.
fix: head EACH-OTHER (reciprocal counterpart of SELF)

lost: A quantity question cannot put WHAT in the quantifier slot; '(WHAT KIND foot)' against the answer '8 foot' do not match in form.
fix: allow WHAT in the quantifier slot; define measure phrase as number + unit

source: will that be / it will be double
lost: 'Will' here is the consequence within a hypothetical (the square does not exist), not future time; FUTURE misreports it.
fix: time-slot particle UNREAL (shared with counterfactuals)

lost: Address by name has no form except the TO phrase of the frame sentence.
fix: none: covered if a speaker/addressee field is added

lost: Stating a measurement uses the same 'equal ... TO' workaround as other nominal predicates.
fix: BE phrase as predicate

lost: 'Hardly' (almost not) becomes flat NOT.
fix: degree slot: BARELY, ALMOST

source: concerns us more than how life itself first originated
lost: With free role order, THAN does not say which argument is compared (concerns us more than it concerns X, or more than X concerns us).
fix: rule: THAN contrasts with the phrase marked by a focus particle, default THEME

lost: Generic 'a nerve' (nerves as a kind) and free-choice 'any' are not distinguished from one particular nerve (bare root) or from ALL.
fix: quantifier ANY; rule for bare root = kind

lost: Intensive 'itself' is approximated by EVEN, which adds an unwanted scalar 'even'.
fix: none: accept EVEN, or attitude scoped to a phrase

lost: 'First' (the initial occurrence) is dropped.
fix: linker NTH + number, usable on events

lost: 'Several' (more than a couple, not many) collapses into SOME.
fix: quantifier slot: FEW, SEVERAL, MANY, MOST

lost: Potentiality inside a triply embedded clause cannot use POSSIBLE (sentence level only); a root 'possible' adds a fourth nesting level.
fix: modal slot: CAN, usable inside blocks

source: and likewise to those coarser vibrations
lost: Coordinating a second TO phrase forces the whole four-level frame (I say that facts make me suspect that it is possible that...) to be repeated in a new sentence.
fix: AND between phrases under one role

lost: A comparative with no stated standard cannot be told from the plain adjective; I had to supply 'THAN light', which the source leaves implicit.
fix: degree slot: MORE / LESS, usable without THAN

lost: The balance of one sentence built on a semicolon is broken into three.
fix: none: out of scope

lost: PLAN is defined as committing the writer; an institution committing itself in the third person relies on reading AGENT committee as the writer.
fix: define PLAN as committing the AGENT named in the clause

source: incoming data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risks / Treasury securities and agency debt and agency mortgage-backed securities
lost: Each three-item list becomes three full sentences repeating predicate, agent and (in the first) a long WHEN clause.
fix: AND between phrases under one role

lost: Continuation of something already under way is carried only by a root 'continue' with a block; no phase marking.
fix: aspect slot: STILL

lost: Degree of commitment has no slot; pushed into a manner phrase WITH strong.
fix: degree slot before a root: VERY ...

lost: Superlative has no construct; a root 'maximum' stands in (otherwise THAN ALL ...).
fix: degree slot: MOST

source: adjustments to the target range for the federal funds rate
lost: Every noun-to-noun relation (to, for, of, about; also 'evidence of their truth' in H04) must be OF or KIND, so the kind of relation is underspecified unless a full clause is built.
fix: allow role particles inside a parenthesised phrase (adjustment (TO range))

lost: A number with a unit has no defined form; '2 «%»' as a KIND modifier is a guess.
fix: define measure phrase as number + unit root or « » unit

summary: The largest single cost was missing phrase-level coordination: every list or paired phrase (H02, H03, H04, H07, H08) became several sentences repeating the whole frame, sometimes four levels deep. The second pattern is that everything modal or graded lives only at sentence level as the writer's stance (strength, attitude): can/must/may, degree (very, hardly, strongly, coarser), phase (still, at last, continue) and hypothetical or counterfactual status had to be faked with content roots such as able, oblige, possible, continue, or were lost. Third, reference is thin: no demonstratives, no we, no generic/any, no speaker field, and handles for arbitrary individuals need a staged ASSUMED scenario; dialogue and quotation double in length. Fourth, the openers fit an assistant reporting on a task but not narration or plain authorial claims, and the relation list lacks 'reason'. Most used: KIND with SELF blocks, NAMED handles, blocks as role heads, ADD, CAUSE/WITH/AT, PAST, NOT, STEP references. Least used: the Logic section (only borrowed for 'twice'), SURPRISE and REGRET, INSTEAD, NO, CONCEDE, LIKELY, and DERIVED with cites.
